summary.text: Gary Simmons is a Democratic delegate representing District 12B in the Maryland House of Delegates and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He took office in January 2023 and is retired from a career in law enforcement and election administration.

paragraphs.text: Gary Simmons was born in Savannah, Georgia, and lives in Maryland.
He earned a B.S. in political science and criminal justice from Tuskegee University in 1990.
His career experience includes work for the board of elections in Suffolk County, New York, the Suffolk County Probation Office, and the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of New York.
After moving to Maryland in 2006, he worked as a special police officer with the U.S. Department of Defense, and he retired in 2017.
Simmons assumed office in the House of Delegates on January 11, 2023, and serves on the Judiciary Committee.
